entities.summary: Nenadi Esther Usman is a Nigerian politician who has served as the National Chairman of the Labour Party since 2026. A former Minister of Finance, she was elected senator of the Federal Republic of Nigeria representing the Kaduna South Senatorial District in the April 2011 elections, running on the People's Democratic Party (PDP) platform.
